question: Who among the following was the court poet of Harshavardhana and the author of ‘Harshacharita’?
solution:
The correct answer is__ Banabhatta.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Banabhatta was the court poet of king Harshavardhana.
 
• Banabhatta wrote Harshvardhan's biography Harshacharita in Sanskrit.
 
• He describes his association with Thanesar in his biography.

About Banabhatta:__

__
 
• A great poet of India, Banabhatta was born around the** 7th century in a village in India.**
 
• He was born in Pritikuta village, which was situated on the banks of Hiranyavahu.
 
• He was born to Chitrabhanu and Rajadevi and he was a family of Vatsyayana gotra.
 
• This poetic genius wrote one of the most famous and earliest novels,** known as Kadambari.**
 
• It is a biographical work of** Harsha and Kadambari.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Rajashekhara was a Sanskrit poet** and playwright who lived in the 9th century CE.

 
 
• He is known for his works such as Karpuramanjari and Bala Ramayana, but he was not a court poet of Harshavardhana.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas was a renowned poet and dramatist **who lived in ancient India, probably in the 4th or 5th century CE.
 
 
• He is known for his works such as Abhijnanasakuntalam, Meghadutam, and Raghuvamsa, but he was not a court poet of Harshavardhana.
 
 
 
• **Aryabhatta was a mathematician and astronomer **who lived in ancient India, probably in the 5th or 6th century CE.
 
 
• He is known for his contributions to the fields of mathematics, astronomy, and astrology, but he was not a court poet of Harshavardhana.
